thread:
maria: Deploybot flagged p50 latency spike on canary and suggested autorevert. Can anyone confirm whether this should auto-rollback?

deploy-bot: [AUTOMATIC] Canary p50 > 350ms threshold breached (p50=410ms) for 6m. Suggested action: auto-revert to v2.13.9 unless suppressed. Reason: latency_regression

kevin: We're in change window but we have a Dedicated pool with pinned v2.14.0 for a customer. Auto-revert would affect hosted only; dedicated remains pinned. We can't run an infra-wide auto-rollback without manual check.

jess: +1 — also seeing a few 502s from edge in us-west. Not sure if it's related to kvcache hotpath.

maria: @kevin deploy-bot can we suppress auto reverts for this rollout? How do we handle release notes / customer comms?

deploy-bot: To suppress auto-revert: run `rdwctl release hold --id=rel_2026_04_09 --suppress-auto-revert true` or add annotation `suppress_autorevert=true` to current rollout. If manual rollback requested, use:
```
rdwctl rollback --to-version=2.13.9 --scope=hosted --reason="latency spike"
```

kevin: I'll hold auto-revert. Running hold now.

kevin: `rdwctl release hold --id=rel_2026_04_09 --suppress-auto-revert true` -> OK

sam: Thanks. I'll open a quick bridge with SRE to validate KV cache flag across canary. Also prepping rollback playbook if we decide to revert.

maria: SRE/support: @support-oncall can you draft a short customer blurb to notify Dedicated customers we're investigating but that pinned fleets aren't impacted? Avoid alarming phrasing.

support-oncall: Drafting: "We're investigating a latency increase observed in canary for hosted API earlier today. Dedicated and pinned instances are unaffected. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes." Want approval to send to customers? :email:

jess: Approve. Also add troubleshooting note in release notes: `Known issue: transient kvcache invalidation may raise p50; workaround: restart worker pool`

kevin: Decision threshold proposal: if error rate > 1% for 10m OR p50 > 400ms for 10m, we execute manual revert of hosted to 2.13.9. Otherwise continue hold and investigate. Agree?

maria: Agreed. I'll monitor metrics and call manual rollback if threshold is hit, tagging @kevin to execute.

sam: Bridge started: https://meet.redwood/bridge/xyz

maria: Update: canary p50 trending down to 360ms, error rate stable at 0.4%. Holding for 20 more minutes.

deploy-bot: [NOTE] Rollout annotation updated: suppress_autorevert=true by kevin at 2026-04-09T15:12Z

maria: Action items: 1) Support sends short memo (support-oncall). 2) Kevin will keep suppress flag and be on-call to run rollback if needed. 3) Jess to add troubleshooting note to release notes. I'll update thread in 15m. :thumbsup:

kevin: Ready to run `rdwctl rollback --to-version=2.13.9 --scope=hosted` if needed. Ping me.

maria: Thanks everyone. Closing out unless we hit thresholds. I'll post final comms after 15m.

maria: Final update: metrics stabilized, no rollback executed. Releasing hold in 30m and updating release notes with the known issue blurb. Closing thread.
